product_metadata.title: Lush Decor Serena Rouched Flower Vintage Chic Farmhouse 3 Piece Comforter Set, Twin XL, Blush
features: Feminine, delicate style ruffled comforter with fabric and fill content made from 100% polyester - perfectly weighted, all season comforter.
Lush Décor Serena comforter is the ideal piece for a shabby chic, textured addition to your bedroom decor.
Elegant, handcrafted ruched flowers give you a charming and romantic king comforter bedding set.
2 piece set includes a twin-xl size comforter (92 Long x 68 Wide inches) and 2 matching shams (20 x 26 inches). 230 GSM comforter.
Due to the delicate nature of the design, these items are dry clean only.
description: Go back to school in style with this unique two-piece comforter set which includes a soft twin XL comforter and a matching pillow sham. The large crafted flowers add interesting texture to your dorm room and make a big design impact in a small space.
